description: Adds one TXT record at the applied domain or host that proves to OsintCat that a company controls this domain. Once the record is seen, the company can let people with addresses at this domain join it and use single sign-on. The record changes nothing else and can be removed later; removing it does not undo a verification already made.
variableDescription: token: the per-domain verification code OsintCat shows the company, 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters (e.g. 3f9a0c1d2b7e4f5a8c6d0e1f2a3b4c5d). The full record value is always osintcat-verify=<token>.
